review: An ID that's mainly focused on Tremor. Rosespanner Meursault only really shines in teams with Tremor, as you can only access the extra Coin Power he has on his skills. It also doesn't help that almost all of his coins require Heads Hit so there will be times where he just won't be able to do anything. His Coin Values are not that great either. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Regret - Fixes clashing and damage issue of Rosespanner Meursault, making him more reliable to use
